method.prompt: Photorealistic close-up on the same snow-covered cobblestone street at New Year Eve dusk, warm windows glowing across the street, the same evening, moments later, small bare feet stepping into fresh snow, toes red with cold. a barefoot girl of about nine with reddish-gold hair under a patched gray coat, clutching a bundle of matchboxes hurries past shuttered shops. Handheld follow. Snow crunch, ragged breathing, a far-off children's choir rehearsing a carol in Korean, wind gusts.
